articles.summary: STEINHAUSEN, Switzerland, Feb. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Transocean Ltd. (NYSE: RIG) today reported financial results for the fourth quarter and full year of 2025. The Company will hold a conference call and webcast at 9 a.m. EST, 3 p.m. CET, on Friday, February 20, 2026, to discuss the results,
articles.title: Transocean Ltd. Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
